answer_1.quote: This work is motivated by two key trends. On one hand, large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable versatility in various generative tasks such as writing, drawing, and question answering...

answer_2.quote: We compute the F1 on each paper then average across papers... we calculate ROUGE and BERTScores between its explanations and our expert's explanations.

answer_3.quote: We evaluate Llama3-8B and -70B... using two prompting strategies: 1) Labeling-All... 2) Select-Deficient...

answer_4.quote: Our annotator team consisted of 40 members from the NLP community, all with multiple first-authored publications in top-tier NLP venues and extensive reviewing experience.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to label each sentence (a) whether it is Deficient, and (b) provide an explanation if it is.
